thread:
maria: quick sync — noticed steady mem growth on long-context regression tests (epochs > 64k tokens). I think KV pages are getting fragmented and the reuse ratio is drifting down. Can we add a few lightweight metrics to distinguish paging vs fragmentation? :thinking:

jon: +1. what metrics do you have in mind?

maria: prototype idea: resident bytes per segment, eviction_count with a reason label, fragment_reuse_ratio, and eviction_wave_duration. Keep them cheap to emit.

arjun: quick warning about label cardinality — model+shard+segment will explode in prod. suggest coarse segment buckets (0-15,16-31,...) and per-segment only in debug mode.

sasha: also add a small sampled per-request residency histogram (sample 1/1000). That helps correlate sequence_length -> residency growth.

jon: sketch of prometheus-friendly names:
```prom
kv_cache_resident_bytes{model=\"<m>\",shard=\"<s>\",segment_bucket=\"0-15\"}
kv_cache_eviction_total{reason=\"age|oom|compaction\",model=\"<m>\",shard=\"<s>\"}
kv_cache_fragment_reuse_ratio{model=\"<m>\"}
kv_cache_residency_sample_histogram_bucket{le=\"...\",model=\"<m>\"}
kv_cache_eviction_wave_seconds{model=\"<m>\",shard=\"<s>\"}
```

arjun: love the names. For prod, rollups by seq_len_bucket and time_window (1m/5m) make sense; per-segment only when we enable heavy diagnostics. Also we should expose a `compaction_runs_total` counter.

maria: ops ask: can eng-sre add dashboard tiles for: hotset churn (reuse_ratio over time), eviction-wave heatmap (shard x time), resident_by_model stacked area, and a low-cardinality fallback aggregated view? :eyes:

ci-bot: deploy pipeline:kv-metrics-proxy v0.12 queued by @maria — staging tests passed.

sasha: I'll mock dashboards in Grafana tomorrow. arjun — can you add the sampling flags to telemetry config?

arjun: yup, will open a PR today with metric toggles and default sampling 1/1000. I'll add an endpoint so we can flip per-shard sampling remotely.

maria: thanks team. goal is to determine if the long-run mem growth is fragmentation (many small fragments, low reuse_ratio) or hotset drifting (resident bytes slowly increasing per-segment). With reuse_ratio + resident_by_segment and eviction_wave we should be able to tell. Ping me if you want traces or flamegraphs.
